mentions.name: Rust web analytics tool
mentions.description: Self-hosted web analytics tool written in Rust that replaces Plausible and Umami; it collects data via a JavaScript beacon and by streaming Caddy access logs.
mentions.source_excerpt: I also completely got rid of self-hosted plausible and umami analytics, and replaced them with vibe-coded built-in-rust (c) analytics tool that relies on both js-beacon and streaming of caddy access.log.
mentions.author: skwee357
